scientific_limitations: The statement concerns full flag varieties and the rho-polarization, not arbitrary partial flags or arbitrary ample weights.
The proof combines classical Borel--Weil, Weyl-dimension, Bruhat-cell, and Weyl-exponent formulas; an older source may contain the same synthesis.
No minimality statement for the rho-embedding is asserted.
title: Universal half-anticanonical degree and the Euler crossover for full flag varieties
